evaluation_method: Chronological rolling one-step-ahead holdout; observed sales from earlier validation dates are used as lag inputs for later dates. Croston SBA is recalculated using observations strictly before each forecast date.
interpretation_note: Lower MAE, RMSE, and WAPE are better. Results describe this dataset and evaluation setup only; they do not guarantee future business performance.

dataset.name: UCI Online Retail
dataset.license: CC BY 4.0; attribution and license details are on the source page
dataset.location_field_note: The source contains no store identifier; country is used as a location proxy only.
dataset.product_selection: Top 100 eligible products by total positive units, with product code as deterministic tie-break.
dataset.zero_fill_assumption: Dates between each product's first and last eligible transaction are filled with zero; this does not prove the product was in stock.

metrics_context.interpretation: Croston SBA WAPE below 100% means its aggregate absolute error is below total actual units in this validation sample. This does not imply good SKU-level accuracy.
